title: Anthropic Launches Prebuilt Automation Gallery for Claude for Legal
summary:
Attorneys using the specialized Claude legal tool now have access to a gallery of prebuilt "artifacts" designed to automate routine tasks such as contract reviews and regulatory scans. These mini-apps allow users to verify if quotes in a brief match their original sources or to flag specific clauses that violate corporate rules, with the AI linking each finding directly to the source document.

The lauch of the gallery includes tools developed by launch partner Harvey, as well as PwC, Goodwin, and Foley & Lardner. As part of the rollout, a new connection via Harvey's MCP server allows business users to submit legal requests through Claude, which the corresponding legal teams then manage and track within the Harvey platform.
